title: The phase diagram of the D1-D5 CFT and localized black holes
summary: In this paper we analyze the phases that dominate the microcanonical ensemble at various energies in the D1-D5 CFT, which is dual to type II string theory on $AdS_3 \times S^3\times T^4$. We focus on black hole solutions, and on the dependence of the phase structure on the ratio of the size of the torus to the AdS scale; as small localized black holes (with horizon topology $S^8$) grow, they can start to fill the $S^3$ or the $T^4$ or both, and we analyze the general aspects of the transitions between the various phases of uniform and non-uniform black holes, incorporating known solutions…
